prompts.name: human-female-v1
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite artwork for a browser-based anime life simulator. Detailed hand-painted anime illustration, believable proportions and materials, fine controlled outlines, layered cel shading with soft ambient occlusion, warm natural daylight, carefully painted fabric/wood/metal details. Premium finished game art, not flat SVG shapes, not pixel art, not toy-like low-poly, not photoreal photography. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no watermark. The supplied room image is a drawing-style/material reference ONLY, not a room to recreate. Create a sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of equal rectangular cells, twelve isolated full-body human sprites. Adult women, natural adult anime proportions approximately six heads tall, anatomical hands and feet, not chibi. Top two rows: one woman with medium warm skin, chestnut shoulder-length hair with a loose ponytail, cream blouse, sage cardigan, charcoal fitted trousers, sneakers. Bottom two rows: a different woman with deep brown skin, long dark wavy hair, lavender casual jacket, ivory top, navy trousers, boots. Each woman repeats consistently across six poses, row-major: front three-quarter standing; walking toward screen-right; back standing; walking toward screen-left; seated on an invisible chair with bent knees and hands reaching to an invisible desk; sleeping lying horizontally on her side with closed eyes. Exactly one person per cell, entire body and hair visible with transparent padding around all sides, no ground, no chair, no bed, consistent identity/clothing across each set. All standing feet share the same baseline, same scale.
